name: Las Ventas con Peña Aguilera (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre of the fly with the crowned arms of Las Ventas con Peña Aguilera (an eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Las Ventas con Peña Aguilera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist
